title: docs: add troubleshooting runbook sorted by monitor symptom
author: Philipp Klinger
patch:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
@@ -105,3 +105,77 @@ docker compose run --rm -T --no-deps web tar -xf - -C /app/media < /srv/backups/
 docker compose up -d
 docker compose ps                                # web healthy
 ```
+
+## Troubleshooting
+
+Sorted by what the monitors report (Videoflix · Web-App, Videoflix · API). Commands run in `/srv/videoflix`. Proxy and certificate problems are in the runbook of [vps-edge](https://github.com/PhilippKlinger/vps-edge#troubleshooting).
+
+### Deploy rolled back
+
+**Symptom:** a short outage during a deploy, the Deploy run is red.
+
+**Check:** the run summary in Actions → Deploy shows the failed step (pull, start, smoke test) and whether the check after the rollback passed.
+
+**Fix:** if the rollback check passed, the server needs nothing; fix the image in the application repository, the next published image deploys again. If it failed, continue with [Regression after deploy](#regression-after-deploy).
+
+**Way back:** none needed, the previous images are running.
+
+### Regression after deploy
+
+**Symptom:** errors shortly after a green deploy (API errors, broken pages).
+
+**Check:** `docker compose ps`, `docker compose logs --since 30m web worker frontend`; compare `docker compose images` and `/version.json` with the deploy summary.
+
+**Fix:** [roll back by hand](#deploy-and-rollback) to the previous digest, one service at a time; mind the limits of a rollback (migrations are not reverted).
+
+**Way back:** deploy the fixed image once it is published.
+
+### Database or cache not ok
+
+**Symptom:** `/api/health/` reports database or cache not ok, the API monitor is down while the web app may still load.
+
+**Check:** `docker compose ps db redis`, `docker compose logs --tail 50 db redis`, `df -h /var/lib/docker` for a full disk.
+
+**Fix:** `docker compose up -d db redis`, then `docker compose restart web`. Disk full → remove old images (`docker image prune`) or old backups; never delete a volume.
+

title: docs: explain how pin pull requests get their required checks
author: Philipp Klinger
patch:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
@@ -57,6 +57,8 @@ All services log to journald instead of `json-file`, because `json-file` can onl
 4. On failure the previous images and commit are restored and checked again; the run stays red
 5. On success a pull request pins the digest in `compose.yaml`; merging it records the state and does not deploy again
 
+**Pin pull requests and required checks:** `main` requires the CI checks, but a pull request opened with the `GITHUB_TOKEN` starts no workflows (GitHub prevents loops). Close and reopen the pin pull request once; the reopen starts the checks, then merge.
+
 Secrets of the Environment: `SSH_HOST`, `SSH_PORT`, `SSH_USER`, `SSH_PRIVATE_KEY`, `SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS`. The server keeps its own `.env`.
 
 **Roll back by hand:** Actions → Deploy → Run workflow, choose the service and enter an earlier digest (the deploy summaries and the history of `compose.yaml` list them). Run this for one service at a time.

title: ci: accept the gosu finding in the Postgres image with expiry
author: Philipp Klinger
patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -156,14 +156,17 @@ jobs:
 
       # Official Trivy image pinned by digest instead of a third-party action.
       # Reports HIGH and CRITICAL, fails on critical findings that already have a fix.
+      # Accepted risks with reason and expiry date: .trivyignore.yaml
       - name: Scan images with Trivy
         run: |
           set -Eeuo pipefail
           failed=0
           for image in $(docker compose config --images | sort -u); do
             echo "::group::${image}"
             docker run --rm "${TRIVY_IMAGE}" image --no-progress --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed "${image}"
-            docker run --rm "${TRIVY_IMAGE}" image --no-progress --quiet --severity CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 "${image}" || failed=1
+            docker run --rm -v "${PWD}/.trivyignore.yaml:/trivyignore.yaml:ro" "${TRIVY_IMAGE}" \
+              image --no-progress --quiet --severity CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed \
+              --ignorefile /trivyignore.yaml --exit-code 1 "${image}" || failed=1
             echo "::endgroup::"
           done
           exit "${failed}"
diff --git a/.trivyignore.yaml b/.trivyignore.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+# Accepted risks for the pinned images, reviewed 2026-11-10.
+# Each entry expires: after that date the CI fails again and the finding has to be reviewed anew.
+# Remove an entry as soon as an image update ships the fix (Dependabot pull request).
+vulnerabilities:
+  - id: CVE-2025-68121
+    paths:
+      - usr/local/bin/gosu
+    statement: >-
+      Go stdlib (crypto/tls session resumption) in gosu of the official Postgres image. gosu only drops
+      privileges once at container start and opens no network or TLS connection.
+    expired_at: 2026-12-10

title: ci: validate, start and scan the pinned production stack
author: Philipp Klinger
patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,169 @@
+# Actions are pinned by commit SHA; the comment shows the readable version.
+# Checks the pinned production combination before it is merged: configuration, scripts,
+# a real start of the stack with its security properties, and a scan of every pinned image.
+# Deploys stay in deploy.yml; this workflow never touches the server.
+name: CI
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+  # Scheduled runs catch image vulnerabilities published after the last push.
+  schedule:
+    - cron: "29 4 * * 1"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+env:
+  TRIVY_IMAGE: aquasec/trivy:0.76.1@sha256:790fd66d1697395d8693d1acaa1ea702406a20f109b6fc7bac8db623eca6c06c
+  ACTIONLINT_IMAGE: rhysd/actionlint:1.7.12@sha256:b1934ee5f1c509618f2508e6eb47ee0d3520686341fec936f3b79331f9315667
+  SHELLCHECK_IMAGE: koalaman/shellcheck:v0.11.0@sha256:61862eba1fcf09a484ebcc6feea46f1782532571a34ed51fedf90dd25f925a8d
+  # Host from .env.example; Django answers only hosts from ALLOWED_HOSTS
+  APP_HOST: videoflix.philipp-klinger.com
+
+jobs:
+  validate:
+    name: Validate compose, scripts and workflows
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      # The template must be complete: every required value is filled with a throwaway one.
+      - name: Create .env from the template
+        run: |
+          set -Eeuo pipefail
+          cp .env.example .env
+          sed -i "s|^SECRET_KEY=$|SECRET_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)|; s|^DB_PASSWORD=$|DB_PASSWORD=$(openssl rand -hex 16)|" .env
+
+      # On the server vps-edge creates this network; here it is a stand-in.

title: chore: add Dependabot version updates
author: Philipp Klinger
patch:
diff --git a/.github/dependabot.yml b/.github/dependabot.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+version: 2
+updates:
+  # Pinned action SHAs in .github/workflows
+  - package-ecosystem: "github-actions"
+    directory: "/"
+    schedule:
+      interval: "weekly"
+    cooldown:
+      default-days: 14
+    commit-message:
+      prefix: "ci(deps)"
+
+  # Postgres and Redis images in compose.yaml
+  - package-ecosystem: "docker-compose"
+    directory: "/"
+    schedule:
+      interval: "weekly"
+    cooldown:
+      default-days: 14
+    commit-message:
+      prefix: "chore(deps)"
+    ignore:
+      # Backend and frontend digests come from the pin PRs of the image CI.
+      - dependency-name: "ghcr.io/philippklinger/*"
+      # A new Postgres major needs a dump and restore; it is upgraded on purpose.
+      - dependency-name: "postgres"
+        update-types: ["version-update:semver-major"]

title: fix: limit memory, cpu and processes of the upload services
author: Philipp Klinger
patch:
diff --git a/compose.yaml b/compose.yaml
@@ -55,6 +55,10 @@ services:
   web:
     <<: *backend
     command: ["web"]
+    # The VPS is shared with other stacks: a crafted upload must not take it down
+    mem_limit: 2g
+    cpus: 2
+    pids_limit: 256
     healthcheck:
       # Django only answers hosts from ALLOWED_HOSTS; /api/health/ is exempt from the HTTPS redirect
       test:
@@ -80,6 +84,10 @@ services:
     # Exactly one worker: ffmpeg conversions run one after another
     <<: *backend
     command: ["worker"]
+    # ffmpeg peaks here; an upload that hits the limit fails, the other stacks keep running
+    mem_limit: 6g
+    cpus: 3
+    pids_limit: 256
     depends_on:
       web:
         condition: service_healthy
@@ -99,6 +107,9 @@ services:
     # Deletes expired demo accounts and their videos every 10 minutes (login checks expiry as well)
     <<: *backend
     command: ["sh", "-c", "while true; do python manage.py delete_expired_demos; sleep 600; done"]
+    mem_limit: 512m
+    cpus: 0.5
+    pids_limit: 64
     depends_on:
       web:
         condition: service_healthy
